headline.text: L3 ML1 was down *7 hours* on a gasket failure in the imperial seal — cleared at 08:40 after sourcing metal-detectable parts.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran three caramel lines. S3 cleared a printer issue that caused wrong best-by dates on MM3 — caught 4 trays, corrected. S3 ran out of Canada trays at 07:17, line paused 41 minutes until trays arrived from Springville. S1 chiller went down at 12:33, came back by 12:45 but issue persists — waiting on programmer response.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 ML2 ramped to 12 mpm and held steady through the shift; recipe saved at 16:50. ML2 scale was reading inaccurate weights overnight; leveled and fixed by 06:01. FFS had a broken roller flagged at 11:29.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 ML1 almond line was down 7 hours after an imperial seal gasket failed and pulled into the pistons at 01:57 — sourcing metal-detectable gasket delayed restart until 08:40. ML4 had repeated gondola jams and broken bars from TG5 exit; upper pusher appears too high, maintenance investigating. MF Matrix started with wrong lot code — 3 pallets on hold, corrected by 08:12. Truffle line ran clean.

notes.text: Whole milk pallets (3) were extended 3 days to 9/19 after organoleptic testing — all acceptable.
ML2 dialed in at 12 mpm — Theegarten tech Sebastian adjusted false rejects and saved recipe.
Maintenance created teflon sliders to prevent gasket damage when installing the hopper on ML1 imperial.

resolved.title: S1 chiller went down during production
resolved.summary: Chiller tripped offline at 12:33, temps rose; line paused.
resolved.resolution: Temps stabilized by 12:45, line restarted — down 12 minutes (Katya Farnsworth).

resolved.title: S4 TG safety module security fault
resolved.summary: TG threw security error on safety module at 17:10, line stopped.
resolved.resolution: Hard reset on TG panel cleared fault, ready to run at 17:43 (Caleb York).

resolved.title: S3 ran out of Canada trays mid-shift
resolved.summary: Line paused at 07:17 — insufficient Canada trays staged, next delivery not until Friday.
resolved.resolution: Emergency trailer dispatched from Springville; trays arrived 07:54, line restarted 08:18 (41 min down).

resolved.title: Cavanna #4 failed allergen test after product changeover
resolved.summary: Metal film entry point on Cavanna #4 did not pass allergen test at shift handoff; passed after cleaning.
resolved.resolution: Cleaned area, QA re-tested at 16:40 — passed (Elizabeth Hernandez).

resolved.title: S3 MM3 printer displayed wrong best-by date
resolved.summary: Printer froze and reset to USA recipe instead of Canada, printing incorrect best-by on MM3.
resolved.resolution: Corrected recipe to Canada spec at 23:48, only 4 trays affected before catch (Luis Falcon).

resolved.title: S3 MM3 printer froze again, wrong recipe loaded
resolved.summary: Printer froze a second time at 05:50, defaulted to USA recipe; caught before more rework created.
resolved.resolution: Operator caught it immediately, corrected to Canada, 4 trays reworked (Brandon Hernandez 06:40).

resolved.title: S3 MM3 settings changed off centerline
resolved.summary: Multiple cam settings and switch position were changed from centerline, causing timing and pouch issues.
resolved.resolution: Troy reset all settings to centerline at 11:30, running better (Troy Baxter).

resolved.title: FFS open bags on long seal
resolved.summary: Flow-wrap producing open pouches on the long seal during 2nd shift startup.
resolved.resolution: Raymond cleaned long seal sealer and adjusted, resolved by 17:27 (Alan Todd).

resolved.title: ML2 scale reading inaccurate weights
resolved.summary: Inline scale not accurate — QA checking previous pallets for potential rework.
resolved.resolution: Scale leveled by Cy, now accurate at 06:01 (Victor Leandro).

resolved.title: ML3 mold jams from bad clamps on demolder
resolved.summary: Brand-new mold clamps coming apart, causing jams at demolder.
resolved.resolution: Replaced clamps with new parts, working well (Fernando Flores 05:27).

resolved.title: ML2 flow-wrap chain loose, causing issues
resolved.summary: Chain tension low on flow-wrap, affecting wrapping quality.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance tightened chain, running well (Fernando Flores 05:27).

resolved.title: ML4 molds stuck on lifting table Z
resolved.summary: Molds jamming on lifting table depositor 2 — back lifting plate stuck in up position.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance adjusted green rails to widen gap on insert side, running at 17:54 (Shane Olsen).

resolved.title: ML1 right rotary valve clogged with almonds
resolved.summary: Almond rotary valve jammed, hopper drained to clean dousing.
resolved.resolution: Cleaned rotary valve and magnet, ATP passed, running at 21:13 (Melissa Zavala 20:28).

resolved.title: ML1 imperial seal gasket failed, pulled into pistons
resolved.summary: Gasket from nozzle plate pulled into pistons at 01:57 — piece missing, 7-hour downtime sourcing metal-detectable replacement.
resolved.resolution: Sourced detectable gasket, ATP passed, all parts clean, line started 08:40 (Rose Smuin, Gina Vazquez).

resolved.title: ML4 TG5 exit belt buildup causing rough bars
resolved.summary: Chocolate and caramel buildup on TG exit frame making bars come in rough.
resolved.resolution: Cleaned buildup with new tool, bars smooth at 21:26 (Shane Olsen).

resolved.title: Truffle Cavanna 2 belt burning edge
resolved.summary: Belt on Cavanna 2 moving to the side, starting to burn the edge.
resolved.resolution: 20-minute gap made for maintenance to fix belt, restarted 03:36 (TruffleLine Enrober).

resolved.title: ML1 C6 belt out of alignment
resolved.summary: C6 belt shifted out of alignment during overnight run.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance adjusted belt at 06:52, centered and running well (Nathan Ruiz 07:01).

resolved.title: MF Matrix wrong lot code at startup
resolved.summary: Line started with incorrect lot code programmed — 3 pallets produced before catch.
resolved.resolution: Lot corrected, 3 pallets on hold, running with correct code at 08:12 (Mirella Mamani).

resolved.title: ML4 depositor 2 water drain clogged
resolved.summary: Drip tray drain on depositor 2 plugged, dripping outside the machine.
resolved.resolution: Lead unclogged drain and verified valve open, working properly at 10:18 (ML4 WDS Tablet 1).

needs_attention.title: S1 chiller recurring faults, waiting on programmer
needs_attention.summary: Chiller went down at 12:33, cleared by 12:45 but root issue persists — Ricardo waiting on programmer response.
needs_attention.status: Temps stable, line running; Vallerie attempting fix on 2nd shift if doesn't hold (Katya 12:53).

needs_attention.title: Condensation dripping onto caramel from overhead pipes
needs_attention.summary: Water condensation on pipes above S2 caramel depositor occasionally getting on product.
needs_attention.status: Curt tagged maintenance to insulate pipes at 18:15; no follow-up on completion.

needs_attention.title: S3 MM3 printer changing settings on its own
needs_attention.summary: Printer froze twice this shift, resetting recipe each time; Troy can't troubleshoot without seeing it break live.
needs_attention.status: Troy monitored, no abnormalities found at 08:11; will watch but hard to fix without live break.

needs_attention.title: Zip tie piece found on S2 salt magnet, not MD-detectable
needs_attention.summary: Operator found zip tie fragment on Hapman salt magnet during inspection; passed through MD without detection — from maintenance work on decorator pipes.
needs_attention.status: Root cause identified (maintenance cleanup from pipe work); prevention plan posted at 09:17 by William Lopez.

needs_attention.title: S2 salt coverage light on sea salt caramels
needs_attention.summary: Salt shaking off into bags during packaging; coverage on pieces looks acceptable but could be better.
needs_attention.status: Ira approved increasing salt at 11:15; team discussing whether more salt will just fall off.

needs_attention.title: ML2 flow-wrap sensor B320 causing false rejects
needs_attention.summary: Getting 4 kickouts every 5 minutes on flow-wrap; sensor won't allow re-teach from HMI.
needs_attention.status: Posted to Theegarten chat for Sebastian's help at 19:13; no resolution as of window close.

needs_attention.title: FFS broken roller flagged
needs_attention.summary: One roller broken on FFS line, maintenance notified.
needs_attention.status: Line down at 11:29, no follow-up on repair or restart.

needs_attention.title: MF Matrix pouch pickup issues causing skipped dumps
needs_attention.summary: Bag material same as bequet twist wrap — poor pickup causing machine to skip product dump on many pouches.
needs_attention.status: Shawn and maintenance working on it; 89% acceptable weight at 08:45, need to improve pouch pick (Shawn).

needs_attention.title: ML4 upper pusher causing broken bars at gondola
needs_attention.summary: Shawn observed 25 bad bars in 30 minutes, all from upper belt — pusher appears too high, trapping bar edge.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance checking rails and pusher height; Nelson investigating as of 09:39.

needs_attention.title: ML4 first licking roller turned off, unknown reason
needs_attention.summary: Licking roller #1 was on last night, found off at shift start; bin not being changed out.
needs_attention.status: Itzel confirmed it was on during morning clean at 14:44; no explanation for why it turned off.
